<subject>Team Meeting on May 9th</subject>
<body>
We will be having a team meeting on May 9th at 4 PM. We will be discussing risk assessments, updating our lending policies, and team changes.  Sandwiches will be provided. I would like to have these meetings on a monthly basis to stay on top of the changing market and to keep everyone updated with changes in the Treasury department.  If you cannot make the meeting or have something in particular you would like discussed, or have a preference in sandwiches, please let me know as soon as possible.

Thanks,
Brandon Baker, Specialist
Halcyon Mutual Bank
0113 230 1947
</body>
